## EENG-340 Generic Project Rubric

| # | Report Section | % | E (Exemplary) | S (Satisfactory) | D (Developing) | U (Unsatisfactory) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **1** | **Introduction, background, purpose etc.** | 5 | There is a strong introduction with a sense of background and purpose. | There is an introduction, but it doesn't give a good idea of background/purpose. | There is very little introduction. | There is no introduction. |
| **2** | **Identify and Formulate problem/design goals (1a)** | 10 | There is a section with this label that seems completely reasonable. | There is a section, that makes sense, that addresses this. | There is a section with this label, but it doesn't actually say much. | There is no section with this label. |
| **3** | **Develop design/solution (1b)** | 15 | There is a viable design. | There is a design, but it's slightly flawed. | There is a design, but it has serious problems. | There is no design here. |
| **4** | **Acquire background knowledge (Data-sheets, etc.) (7a)** | 10 | There is a reference to datasheets or papers that makes sense. | There is a mention of datasheets, but the relationship to design is unclear. | There is no reference to datasheets or papers. | There is no reference to anything. |
| **5** | **Design judgements (Global, Econ, Soc, Env) (4b)** | 10 | There is a section addressing design judgements. | (Partial) Design judgements are mentioned but not fully developed. | (Partial) Design judgements are vague or generic. | There is no section addressing design judgements. |
| **6** | **Conduct Experiments, acquire data (6a)** | 15 | There is a strong set of experiments used to validate the designs. | There is a set of experiments, but they could easily be improved. | There are missing experiments, or they are deeply flawed. | There is no evidence of experiments. |
| **7** | **Conduct Simulations, make predictions (6b)** | 10 | There are numerous simulation results that show good results. | There are some simulations, but not a lot. | There are only one or two simulations. | There are no simulations. |
| **8** | **Interpret Results, draw inferences (6c)** | 20 | Strong evidence of interpreting simulations and experimental results. | Some evidence of interpreting simulations and experimental results. | Small amount of interpretation of simulations and experimental results. | No evidence of interpretation of results. |
| **9** | **Summary/Conclusion** | 5 | Strong concluding summary of findings and design outcomes. | A summary is present but lacks depth or clear conclusion. | Summary is extremely brief or missing key findings. | No summary or conclusion is present. |
|  | **Total** | **100** |  |  |  |  |
